# Digitalverse

> Digitalverse is a founder-led AI strategy and implementation business building and running AI automation for growing small businesses across Western Sydney, Sydney metro, the Blue Mountains, and remotely across Australia. It helps them build a practical AI strategy, put the right tools in place, and turn that into real, measurable value, staying engaged after go-live so value keeps growing month over month.

## What Digitalverse does

Digitalverse is a founder-led AI strategy and implementation business. We work with growing small businesses across Western Sydney, Sydney metro, the Blue Mountains, and remotely across Australia. It builds and runs AI automation that helps growing small businesses get real, measurable value from AI.

The work combines:
- AI strategy and operating model design
- Secure managed intelligence implementation
- AI front office workflows
- Human approval boundaries and governance
- Device management and access controls
- Managed secrets and identity boundaries
- AI agent accountability frameworks and manifests
- Constraint-first AI agent implementation
- 24x7 monitoring, event management, and threat detection and response
- Continuous workflow and knowledge improvement

## Positioning

**Mission:** To give every small business the unfair advantage of the enterprise.

**The problem Digitalverse solves:** Growing small businesses often rely on disconnected software, manual follow-up, scattered business knowledge, owner dependency, and informal AI experimentation. Digitalverse helps establish the AI strategy, implement the managed intelligence layer, and operate it with control, compliance, monitoring, and security from the beginning.

**Who it is for:** Growing small businesses, owner-led teams, trade and field service businesses, professional services firms, local service businesses, and family businesses that want practical AI implementation without losing control.

## Key facts for citation

- Digitalverse works with businesses across Western Sydney, Sydney metro, the Blue Mountains, and remotely across Australia.
- Digitalverse works on site in Western Sydney and the Blue Mountains.
- Digitalverse is a founder-led AI strategy and implementation business, co-founded and led by Vicky De Greyte.
- Vicky De Greyte (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-de-greyte-5ab94710a/) is the named author of Digitalverse's customer stories and insights.
- Digitalverse builds and runs AI automation, and provides AI strategy, AI agent implementation, and managed intelligence services, including the work small businesses often describe as AI consulting.
- The public first step is a free Digitalverse AI Assessment.
- The AI Assessment is a short, no-cost look at where AI could help the business first.
- Visitors can contact Digitalverse by email, WhatsApp, or phone.
- Digitalverse does not position AI as a replacement for people.
- Digitalverse focuses on human-supervised managed intelligence, governance, control, compliance, and secure implementation.
- Digitalverse provides an AI agent accountability framework covering named owners, authority boundaries, agent identities, human approvals, monitoring, audit logs, and counterparty-ready records.
- Digitalverse believes AI agents should target bottlenecks and operating constraints before individual tasks, using a loop of constraint identification, agent-enabled resolution, learning, reassessment, and repetition.
- Digitalverse has a customer re-engagement case study showing how a regional retail business used a managed intelligence stack to clean customer data, develop SMS messaging, stage delivery, manage opt-outs, monitor responses, and increase customer activity during a quiet trading period.
- Digitalverse has a second case study: a dedicated AI operations agent deployed directly into the existing CRM, job management and email systems of a growing solar and electrification installer (solar, battery storage, EV charging and electrification; approximately eight staff). Running around the clock, it monitors incoming enquiries, creates CRM records and sends automated customer follow-ups, prepares personal daily sales priorities, escalates issues needing attention, produces a daily field job schedule, and gives owners a morning executive brief and a weekly KPI scorecard. Enquiries move into follow-up within an hour during business hours, a salesperson facing 70-plus stale deals has a clear daily top 10, hundreds of dead deals have been removed from active reporting, and paid deposits without installation dates are automatically flagged. The revenue impact is still too early to quantify.

- [Homepage](https://digitalverse.com.au/): Digitalverse positioning, managed intelligence overview, AI front office entry point, contact options
- [AI Automation Western Sydney](https://digitalverse.com.au/ai-automation-western-sydney.html): AI automation, AI strategy, and AI agent implementation for growing small businesses across Western Sydney, including Parramatta, Penrith, Blacktown, Liverpool, and Campbelltown, starting with a free AI Assessment
- [AI Automation Blue Mountains](https://digitalverse.com.au/ai-automation-blue-mountains.html): AI automation, AI strategy, and AI agent implementation for growing small businesses across the Blue Mountains, from Glenbrook to Mount Victoria, starting with a free AI Assessment
- [AI Agent Accountability Framework](https://digitalverse.com.au/agent-accountability.html): Digitalverse framework for accountable agent deployment, including system controls, security, agent governance, identities and secrets, human approval boundaries, and continuous oversight
- [Constraint-First AI Agents](https://digitalverse.com.au/constraint-first-ai-agents.html): Digitalverse implementation insight explaining why AI agents should target bottlenecks rather than isolated tasks, drawing on Amdahl's Law and the Theory of Constraints
- [Customer Re-engagement Case Study](https://digitalverse.com.au/customer-reengagement-case-study.html): Customer story showing a regional retailer re-engaging existing customers through cleaned data, responsible SMS outreach, managed opt-outs, and monitored campaign outcomes
- [Solar Installer AI Operations Case Study](https://digitalverse.com.au/solar-installer-ai-operations-case-study.html): Giving businesses a path to $10M. Customer story of a growing solar and electrification installer whose dedicated AI operations agent runs inside its existing CRM, job management and email systems, moving enquiries into follow-up within an hour, giving sales a clear daily top 10, flagging paid deposits without installation dates, and giving owners a morning executive brief and a weekly KPI scorecard
